name: shinchantw_cbt_d1_retention_by_10_10_progress_20260731_192507_603404
sql:
/*
7/29 创角用户：按 7/29 当天的主线最终进度，比较 7/30（D1）登录留存。
仅保留入门:10-1~10-9、入门:10-10、简单Ⅰ:1-1~1-10，排除更早与更深进度玩家。
*/
WITH UserBlacklist AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" AS user_id FROM user_result_cluster_18
    WHERE cluster_name IN ('internal_users', 'is_windows', 'is_water')
), CohortUsers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT v."#account_id" AS account_id FROM ta.v_event_18 v
    LEFT JOIN UserBlacklist b ON v."#user_id" = b.user_id
    WHERE v."$part_event" = 'new_role' AND v."$part_date" = '2026-07-30'
      AND v."#account_id" IS NOT NULL AND b.user_id IS NULL
), MainStageProgress AS (
    SELECT v."#account_id" AS account_id,
           MAX(COALESCE(TRY_CAST(v.a_rst[1].id AS BIGINT), TRY_CAST(v.stage_id AS BIGINT))) AS max_stage_id
    FROM ta.v_event_18 v INNER JOIN CohortUsers c ON v."#account_id" = c.account_id
    LEFT JOIN UserBlacklist b ON v."#user_id" = b.user_id
    WHERE v."#event_name" = 'stage_fight' AND TRY_CAST(v.a_rst[1].key AS INTEGER) = 1001
      AND v."$part_date" = '2026-07-30' AND b.user_id IS NULL
    GROUP BY 1
), ProgressGroups AS (
    SELECT account_id,
           CASE WHEN max_stage_id BETWEEN 451 AND 495 THEN '入门:10-1~10-9'
                WHEN max_stage_id BETWEEN 496 AND 500 THEN '入门:10-10内'
                WHEN max_stage_id BETWEEN 501 AND 550 THEN '简单Ⅰ:1-1~1-10' END AS progress_group
    FROM MainStageProgress
), D1Login AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT v."#account_id" AS account_id FROM ta.v_event_18 v
    LEFT JOIN UserBlacklist b ON v."#user_id" = b.user_id
    WHERE v."$part_event" = 'login' AND v."$part_date" = CAST(DATE_ADD('day', 1, DATE '2026-07-30') AS VARCHAR)
      AND b.user_id IS NULL
)
SELECT p.progress_group AS "7月29日主线最终进度", COUNT(DISTINCT p.account_id) AS "7月29日创角人数",
       COUNT(DISTINCT d.account_id) AS "7月30日登录人数",
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT d.account_id) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT p.account_id), 0), 2) AS "D1留存率(%)"
FROM ProgressGroups p LEFT JOIN D1Login d ON p.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE p.progress_group IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY CASE p.progress_group WHEN '入门:10-1~10-9' THEN 1 WHEN '入门:10-10内' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END;
